card.name: "Without" before no-adverse-interaction statements
card.fires_on: The word "without" (or "any" right after it) in drug interaction sections, where a drug is said to have been given with other drugs without evidence of adverse interactions. Also weakly on a few similar linking words such as "that" or "Known" in other lists.

modes.label: Without after co-administered drugs
modes.description: "without" follows a list of drugs given together and introduces a claim of no adverse interaction.
modes.example: hydralazine, prazosin and digoxin<< without>> evidence of clinically significant adverse interactions.

modes.label: "any" after "without"
modes.description: "any" follows "without" in a statement that no adverse interaction was seen.
modes.example: Doxazosin has been administered without<< any>> evidence of an adverse drug interaction to patients

modes.label: Other scattered cases
modes.description: Rare hits on words like "that" or "Known" in legal or contraindication lists.
modes.example: CATIONS DUAVEE is contraindicated in women with any of the following conditions: • Undiagnosed abnormal uterine bleeding •<< Known>>, suspected, or past history of breast

card.writes: It pushes toward words of absoluteness or persistence such as relentless, indefinite, and never, and away from compromise words.
card.plain: It marks the word "without" in sentences saying a drug was used alongside others with no interaction problems seen.
